Carpenter – Full-Time
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $80,000 – $110,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking experienced and motivated Carpenters to join our growing team on a full-time basis.
About the Role

As a Carpenter, you will be responsible for constructing, installing, repairing, and maintaining timber and metal structures used across mining, industrial, commercial, and construction projects. You will work closely with supervisors, engineers, and other trades to ensure all carpentry work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project specifications and Australian Standards.

Key Responsibilities
•	Read and interpret construction drawings, plans, blueprints, and specifications.
•	Measure, cut, shape, assemble, and install timber, plywood, steel framing, and other building materials.
•	Construct, install, and repair formwork, flooring, walls, ceilings, partitions, doors, windows, and roofing components.
•	Install fixtures, fittings, cladding, handrails, stairs, and other structural components.
•	Carry out maintenance and repair work on existing buildings, structures, and site facilities.
•	Operate hand tools, power tools, and woodworking machinery safely and efficiently.
•	Ensure all carpentry work complies with building codes, project specifications, and workplace safety requirements.
•	Inspect completed work to ensure high-quality workmanship and compliance with quality standards.
•	Work collaboratively with supervisors, engineers, and other tradespeople to complete projects within required timeframes.
•	Maintain accurate records of work completed, materials used, and maintenance activities where required.
•	Assist in mentoring apprentices and junior carpenters.
•	Follow all workplace health and safety policies, procedures, and environmental requirements.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1–2 years of full-time experience as a Carpenter or in a similar carpentry role.
•	Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and technical specifications.
•	Strong knowledge of carpentry techniques, building materials, and construction methods.
•	Experience using hand tools, power tools, and woodworking equipment.
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team in industrial, commercial, or construction environments.
•	Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
•	Commitment to workplace safety and quality workmanship.
•	Excellent communication and organisational skills.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $80,000 – $110,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining, industrial, and construction projects.
•	Ongoing training and career development.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.

Location: 		Salisbury, QLD, 4107
Full-Time: 		Immediate start
Job Title: 		Metal Fabricator
Salary range: 		$79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date:	30 days

About the Role
On behalf of our client - a leading structural steel fabricator specialising in commercial, industrial, and infrastructure projects - we are seeking an experienced Metal Fabricator. The company operates a state-of-the-art facility with advanced CNC, plasma cutting, and automated welding equipment, delivering precision-engineered steelwork for high-profile builds. This role is critical to maintaining their reputation for quality, safety, and on-time delivery.

Key Duties & Responsibilities
Preparation & Planning
• Interpret complex blueprints, shop drawings, and specifications to determine material requirements, weld symbols, and assembly sequences.
• Conduct material take-offs and plan efficient cutting layouts to minimise waste, liaising with detailers and project managers.

Cutting & Shaping
• Operate CNC plasma cutters, oxy-fuel torches, and band saws to cut structural steel sections (beams, columns, channels) to precise dimensions.
• Shape and bend metal sections and pipes using hydraulic presses, rollers, and manual methods (heating, hammering) to achieve required profiles.

Assembly & Joining
• Align and tack components using clamps, jigs, and measuring instruments (levels, squares, tape measures) to ensure dimensional accuracy.
• Join steel sections via flux-cored arc welding (FCAW), MIG, or stick welding, as well as bolting and riveting for field connections.

Finishing & Quality Control
• Inspect welds for bead width, penetration, and uniformity; perform non-destructive testing (visual, dye penetrant) as required.
• Grind, file, and polish welds and surfaces to specified finish; apply protective coatings or acid washes to prevent corrosion.

Essential Qualifications & Experience
• Certificate III in Engineering - Fabrication Trade or equivalent qualification
• Minimum 2 years' post-apprenticeship experience in metal fabrication and welding within an industrial environment
• Proficiency in reading engineering drawings and using manual/machine tools.
• Strong welding skills (FCAW/MIG) and knowledge of Australian welding standards.
• Commitment to workplace safety and quality assurance.

Essential Skills & Attributes
• Exceptional attention to detail with commitment to producing high-quality craftsmanship
• Strong problem-solving skills with ability to troubleshoot fabrication and welding challenges
• Physical capability to handle heavy materials and work in demanding industrial environments
• Excellent teamwork and communication skills with ability to collaborate effectively with tradespeople and engineers
• Reliability and strong work ethic with commitment to meeting project deadlines and quality standards
• Adaptability to work across diverse projects and willingness to continuously develop technical skills

To Apply
If you are an experienced Metal Fabricator/Welder seeking a permanent role with an industry leader, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications through the application portal.

Please note: We are managing this recruitment process on behalf of our client. All applications will be reviewed by our team before being presented to the client.

About Us
We have been making an impression since 1903 — making us Australia's oldest signage company. From our Sunshine West facility we design, fabricate, install and maintain signage for some of the country's best-known brands, covering everything from illuminated pylon signs and shopfronts through to large-format architectural and retail projects.

Our workshop is the heart of the business. We are looking for a skilled Fabricator / Welder to join our production team.

About the role
Reporting to the Production Manager, you will fabricate signage components and structures from mild steel, stainless steel and aluminum — working from shop drawings through to a finished product ready for paint, powder coat and installation.

Day to day you will:
Fabricate sign frames, lightboxes, pylon structures, brackets and mounting hardware
MIG and TIG weld aluminum, mild steel and stainless steel to a high finish standard
Read and interpret engineering drawings, shop drawings, specifications and cut lists
Measure, mark out, cut, fold, drill, grind and lines to tolerance
Assemble and trial-fit structures, including housings for illuminated and LED components
Prepare completed work for surface finishing and dispatch
Carry out quality checks against specification before sign-off
Maintain a clean, safe and organised work area and comply with all WHS requirements

About you
Essential
Trade qualification in Engineering – Fabrication (Boilermaker / Metal Fabricator), or equivalent demonstrated experience
Proven MIG and TIG welding ability, particularly on aluminum
Confident reading and working directly from technical drawings
Strong attention to detail and pride in finish quality — signage is a visual product and welds are often seen
Reliable, safety-focused, and comfortable working both autonomously and as part of a small team
Full working rights in Australia

Highly regarded
Previous experience in signage, sheet metal or architectural metal fabrication
Forklift license, EWP (yellow card) and/or Construction Induction (White) Card
Exposure to CNC routing, folding equipment or powder coat preparation

What's on offer
Full-time, ongoing position with a stable, long-established Australian business
$80,000 – $90,000 + superannuation, based on experience and trade qualification
Consistent hours with overtime available
Well-equipped workshop and on-site parking
Genuine variety — no two jobs are the same
A close-knit production team with long-tenured tradespeople

How to apply
Click Apply and submit your resume. Applications are treated in strict confidence. Only candidates with full Australian working rights will be considered.

Asset Conformity Testing Services (ACTS) is an established, NATA-accredited ISO/IEC 17020 inspection body delivering independent asset inspection, testing, and integrity services across the mining and mineral processing, oil and gas, manufacturing, construction, rail, and port sectors.

We are looking for a certified and experienced Plant Inspector to join our Perth Inspection Team to conduct Plant inspections throughout Western Australia. You will ideally have experience in a similar inspection role. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a young company and play an important role in our growth journey. 
The role includes FIFO (rostered or project-based) and Perth metro work, based out of our High Wycombe office, Monday to Friday with overtime as required.
You will work alongside project engineers, maintenance teams, HSE personnel and other relevant stakeholders to ensure all plant meets regulatory requirements and industry best practice. API510 or AICIP is essential.
